description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class for the DateTimeHelperService, testing various date and time utility functions such as formatting, comparison, range generation, timezone handling, and week boundary calculations.

classes.name: DateTimeHelperServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the functionality of the DateTimeHelperService class, covering date formatting, comparison, range generation, timezone handling, and week boundary determination.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the DateTimeHelperService instance before each test.

methods.name: testFormatDateTimeToYmd
methods.description: Tests the formatting of DateTime objects to 'Y-m-d' string representation, including UTC conversions and null cases.

methods.name: testFormatDateTimeToTimeString
methods.description: Tests the formatting of DateTime objects to 'HH:MM' time strings, including timezone conversions and null cases.

methods.name: testIsDatesEqual
methods.description: Tests the comparison of two DateTime objects for date equality considering timezone differences and null cases.

methods.name: testDateDiffInHours
methods.description: Checks the calculation of hours difference between two DateTime objects, including fractional hours.

methods.name: testDateRange
methods.description: Validates the generation of date ranges with different start/end dates and interval specifications.

methods.name: assertDateArray
methods.description: Helper method to assert that an array of DateTime objects matches expected date strings.

methods.name: testGetNow
methods.description: Verifies that the getNow method returns current DateTime with correct timezone and offset.

methods.name: testGetTimezoneByTimezoneOffset
methods.description: Tests the mapping from numeric timezone offsets to DateTimeZone objects.

methods.name: testGetWeekBoundaryForGivenDate
methods.description: Tests the calculation of start and end dates of a week boundary for given date and week start position.
